main_topics: Turnaround in staffing and recruitment sector

recommendations.speaker: Krimpen
recommendations.reasoning: Undervalued with P/E around 10 despite 30% annual profit growth over 5 years and strong structural growth. Gaming sector has low valuations due to ESG restrictions but quality companies should benefit from regulated markets.
recommendations.quote: Kindred är billig på nuvarande meriter. Värderingen ligger väl nu strax över 10 i p-tal, och de har haft en vinsttillväxt på 30% per år de senaste fem åren, så jag tycker det ser jättebilligt ut.

recommendations.speaker: Krimpen
recommendations.reasoning: Identified as the best company on the stock market with exceptional historical performance.
recommendations.quote: När man kollar staplarna på börsdata så blir man ju nästan tårhög. Det är ju liksom, det är pår.

recommendations.speaker: Ola
recommendations.reasoning: Strong Q2 report with record margins and positive outlook on recruitment demand. Net cash of 4 SEK per share and attractive valuation at P/E around 11. Long-term goal to double revenue over 5 years.
recommendations.quote: På våra nya prognos, knappt 12, nästan 11 nu eftersom det har gått ner ganska mycket de sista dagen här. Det tycker vi är attraktivt och vi har köpt in en aktie i SGR efter Q2 rapporten.

recommendations.speaker: Krimpen
recommendations.reasoning: Series acquirer with potential for future acquisitions and margin improvements. Good historical track record of creating value through spinoffs.
recommendations.quote: Jag tror att framåt kommer vi att se lite mera förvärv låter det som. Jag har haft lite kontakt med bolaget här och jag tror också att vi kommer att se högre marginaler här då.

summary: This episode discusses investment philosophy emphasizing quality, value, and long-term thinking. The hosts analyze NGS as a turnaround opportunity and SJR positively after a strong Q2. Guest Krimpen shares his value investing approach and recommends gaming stocks Kindred and Evolution Gaming as undervalued opportunities. Discussion covers series acquirers, ESG impact on gaming valuations, and warnings about biotech and mining stocks.
key_takeaways: Investment philosophy should focus on quality companies with proven profitability and reasonable valuations
Staffing and recruitment sector showing signs of recovery after COVID with NGS and SJR presenting opportunities
Gaming sector offers attractive valuations due to ESG restrictions but quality companies should benefit from regulated markets
Series acquirers can create significant value through acquisitions and spinoffs
Avoid biotech and mining stocks due to high risk and unpredictability
